reading.text:
Common setting (paper §1-§2, used by every reading below). Horizon T>0, dimensions n,m,d>=1.
H = R^n x R^m x R^{m x d} x L^2(nu;R^m) with the l^2-combined norm
|theta|_H^2 = |x|^2+|y|^2+|z|_F^2+||u||_{L^2(nu)}^2 (Euclidean on vectors, Frobenius on matrices,
L^2(nu) on the fibre; u an a.e.-class). P_2(H): Borel probability measures on H with finite second
moment, metrised by W_2 built on |.|_H. Coefficients are deterministic functions
b:[0,T]xHxP_2(H)->R^n, sigma:->R^{n x d}, h:->L^2(nu;R^n), f:->R^m, g:R^n x P_2(R^n)->R^m.
Diagonal input at t: Theta in L^2(Omega,F_t;H) on the standing basis together with mu=Law(Theta).
All hypotheses are diagonal (mu never varied independently of Theta), interior ones for a.e. t in
[0,T] with the null time set chosen before the inputs, terminal ones for all X_T,X'_T in
L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n) with induced laws rho=Law(X_T). The standing filtration is the usual augmentation
of the one generated by W, N and an independent F_0. Since the stability constant is claimed
dimension-free, norm choices matter: Euclidean/Frobenius/L^2(nu) norms (or a choice differing from
them only by dimension-free factors) are required wherever a definition enters a quantitative bound.

UNIT def:Dissertation.WellPosedness.Spec.LipTerminal
Paper notion: the terminal half (2.6) of Assumption 2.3: for all X_T, X'_T in L^2(Omega,F_T;R^n),
with rho=Law(X_T), rho'=Law(X'_T) in P_2(R^n),
  |g(X_T,rho)-g(X'_T,rho')| <= L(|X_T-X'_T| + W_2(rho,rho')) almost surely.
What a faithful Lean definition must be: for all F_T-measurable square-integrable X_T, X'_T :
Omega -> R^n (Euclidean), the a.s. inequality with g evaluated at the pushforward laws (diagonal),
W_2 on P_2(R^n) for the Euclidean norm, same L as the interior part. F-measurable vs F_T-measurable
inputs: F_T is the terminal sigma-field; if F = F_T in the setting or the condition depends only on
joint laws and F_T carries a uniform variable (T>0, Remark 2.9), quantifying over F-measurable
inputs is equivalent.

‖g (XT ω) (lawP2 P XT) − g (XT' ω) (lawP2 P XT')‖ ≤ L * (‖XT ω − XT' ω‖ + w2P (lawP2 P XT)
(lawP2 P XT')).
- All X_T, X'_T ∈ L²(Ω,F_T;ℝⁿ): F_T-strongly measurable square-integrable functions (ℱ T of the
  standing filtration). Match (representatives, as for LipInteriorAt).
- Laws ρ = Law(X_T): lawP2 P XT = P.map XT for MemLp. Diagonal. Match.
- Inequality a.s., Euclidean norms, W₂ = w2P on P2 (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) for the Euclidean
  norm. Match. Same L as the interior (enforced in Assumption23).
Verdict: faithful.
